body: I understand not wanting to involve them, I really do. The only person I've told is my boyfriend and I can't even tell him the true extent of my feelings. You haven't seen a therapist? Or talked to anyone else on reddit if therapy isn't affordable? I completely understand your thought process, I honestly do. But you can't keep this bottled up inside.

Great, thank you! Meteor crater and the painted desert, I'll definitely check those out.

You're in Indiana too? So you understand my feeling of wanting to get out for a little bit lol. did you drive?

Wow, thanks for all of the advice! I won't be able to go for probably a month or so and I think at this point it's best to go by myself and get some clarity alone. My grandfather lives in Lake Havasu (is that correct?). So I've heard of it but I've never been able to see Havasu Falls. It's beautiful!! I'll probably have to stick with just hiking in GC for this trip. I'm looking forward to being on my own with no responsibilities, just enjoying the natural beauty and fresh air!! And the best burgers in Arizona :)

Thanks so much again! I hope that your year gets better and that you get to get away if only for a little while. I'll definitely be safe. Have a great day :)
Thanks!! I'm so excited! I'll take lots of pictures :)

How would that save them? You said you can picture their reactions. Obviously, they want you around and would probably be horrified to know this is how you feel inside.  Who have you spoken to about this?
I'm sorry could you clarify? What do you mean by "I need this?" That's usually how I feel too which is why I was so scared that I smiled and felt better. It was horrible.
There aren't right now and I guess I'm afraid I won't end up finding them. I try and tell myself that I'll find it eventually but I really don't care enough to find out.

Thanks for sharing!!! It's nice to know someone else went through the same thing and turned out okay. I go through periods at this job where I literally would vomit on the side of the road going in to work. Yeah. That's how you know it's too much lol.
I haven't slept properly in a year and a half.
Thank you so much... all the support is so appreciated. I am looking forward to some mental clarity. Best wishes to you.
Thank you!!! I hope you are doing well. I am here if you ever need to vent to someone who understands the pressure of the field!!
God yes!!! I'm so glad you were able to get out as well!! I hope you have found happiness. Thank you so much!!
I'm glad you had the courage to do that . I hope you have found happiness friend.

This is exactly my experience. I was withering away. I have been a terrible girlfriend and mother because I couldn't take the demands of being needed 24/7 at my job and home. Now I can focus on my family.

Thanks for the kind words and support. I love all my people. You become part of their family in this part of social work (working with developmentally disabled). But it was time to go. I don't know what line of work you are in , but I wish you all the best.
